nodeDesign.recommended: Set the existing MOZ_ASSUME_NODE_RUNNING switch to exactly 1 only in the controlled smoke child environment, leave MOZHTTP2_PORT and other invented server ports unset, and state that no HTTP/2 server is started or qualified for these network-independent cases.
nodeDesign.why: Pinned trySetupNode returns before resolving NODEJS or creating MozHttp2Server when the switch is truthy. Missing HTTP2 port is a warning, which is consistent with fixed nonnetwork tests. A switch name or stock informational message is not evidence that an external server exists.
scope: compiled DEBUG and AppConstants/version positive fixture
original upstream version comparator test with explicit manifest and single absolute file

alternatives.assessment: Unnecessary for these fixed cases; changes the stock harness semantics and adds maintenance and patch verification.
Needed if an actual detached HTTP2 server becomes part of the requested test scope; unnecessary when its creation is prevented. Do not claim the stage PGID covers a started detached server.

nodeDesign.HTTP3: The switch does not suppress startHttp3Server. Its subprocess inherits the stage group in the pinned code and remains within existing resource/cleanup accounting. Missing server or ERROR records must not be silently treated as clean success.
nodeDesign.xpcshellChild: Pinned launchProcess calls psutil.Popen or subprocess.Popen without a new session/group argument; keep the fixed selected tests network-independent and do not broaden this to arbitrary child-process tests.
nodeDesign.dumpTests: Do not use --dump-tests as a no-execution probe: servers start before buildTestList, whose dump-tests branch calls sys.exit before the normal shutdown calls.
nodeDesign.retryAndSelection: Use explicit manifest and one absolute selected file, --verbose --sequential --threads 1, and remove only MOZ_AUTOMATION from the clean child environment where required to prevent automatic harness retry; preserve its actual failure result and require exact selected-test lifecycle.
nodeDesign.controls: Five independently extracted pinned trySetupNode controls used a stub server and no real process. Switch 1 without port: zero starts plus one warning; switch 1 with port: zero starts; string 0 is also truthy and skips, so configure exactly 1; default with NODEJS: one stub start; no NODEJS: zero starts plus warning.

readerReview.fileBounds: Owned regular file, no-follow/nonblocking descriptor, exact pre/post file identity, complete UTF-8 JSONL, strict duplicate-key and nonfinite-JSON rejection, byte/line/record/test bounds.
readerReview.selection: Exactly matching suite IDs, one suite start/end, each selected test starts/ends once, no retries/duplicates or incomplete groups; verbose logging is required to avoid ambiguous replay after test_end.
readerReview.positive: Only complete expected PASS lifecycles with no skip/unexpected/failure/error/crash/timeout/nonzero process exit satisfy the control; source-bound upstream zero-subtest tests are allowed.
readerReview.negative: Require exactly one selected unexpected FAIL subtest and FAIL test end, exact fixed failure marker and no additional failures; receipt status remains failed even when expectationSatisfied is true.
readerReview.markerBinding: Exact INFO marker is credited only within the suite while exactly one selected test is active; an optional row test ID must match it. Missing test field remains supported for stock head.info.
readerReview.publicPrivacy: Only bounded counts, fixed statuses/reasons, marker booleans and full file size/hash are returned. Raw selected IDs, paths, messages, process metadata and marker strings are omitted.
readerReview.callerResponsibilities: Reader does not verify real harness exit status, immutable source/binary binding, timing or cleanup. The integration must independently require the actual intended positive/negative exit, monitored ownership and cleanup proof.

resolvedFinding.problem: The original debug INFO marker was credited before/after suite or test execution and even with a foreign test ID.
resolvedFinding.fix: Bind marker to unique active selected test; outside/foreign/ambiguous events do not satisfy it.
resolvedFinding.additionalTests: Six added cases cover suite-before, test-after, suite-after, foreign ID, stock missing-test-field positive, and multiple-active negative.

This component review does not review the unfinished smoke integration, authorize a new workflow or qualify broad Firefox/browser-chrome/network/native authentication coverage.
